Bill.BriefDescription: Developing plans to address the housing needs of homeless persons.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to developing plans to address the housing needs ofhomeless persons; adding a new section to chapter 36.01 RCW; adding anew section to chapter 35.21 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter35A.21 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each county shall create a task force to develop a tenyearplan addressing shortterm and longterm housing for homeless persons. Membership on the task force must include representatives of thecounties, cities, towns, housing authorities, civic and faithorganizations, schools, community networks, human services providers,law enforcement personnel, criminal justice personnel, includingprosecutors, probation officers, and jail administrators, substanceabuse treatment providers, mental health care providers, emergencyhealth care providers, businesses, and at-large representatives of thecommunity. (2) In addition to developing a tenyear plan to end homelessness, p. 1 SB 5767each task force shall establish guidelines, as needed, for thefollowing: (a) Emergency shelters; (b) Shortterm housing needs; (c) Temporary encampments; (d) Supportive housing for chronically homeless persons; and (e) Longterm housing. Guidelines must include, when appropriate, standards for health andsafety and notifying the public of proposed facilities to house thehomeless. (3) Each county shall report to the appropriate committees of thelegislature by January 2006, including information on guidelinesdeveloped, potentials for public-private partnerships to addresshomelessness, and requests for further involvement or support from thelegislature. Each county shall continue to develop and coordinateplanning efforts, with reports to the legislature of substantivechanges and significant additional information.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each city or town must participate in the task force created undersection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35A.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each code city must participate in the task force created undersection 1 of this act.
